parameters.name: BusinessType
parameters.description:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn\_log\_access\_l1. Valid values:

- **cdn\_log\_access\_l1**: access logs of L1 Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

- **cdn\_log\_origin**: back-to-origin logs

- **cdn\_log\_er**: EdgeRoutine logs

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region where Log Service resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**

- **cn-shanghai**

- **cn-qingdao**

- **cn-beijing**

- **cn-zhangjiakou**

- **cn-shenzhen**

- **eu-central-1**

- **us-west-1**

- **ap-south-1**

- **ap-southeast-1**
